yt.title: Without Einstein, GPS would drift {c_km} km a day #Shorts
yt.description:
GPS satellite clocks gain about 38 microseconds per day from general and special relativity combined. Computed with Einstein's formulas.
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.text: Without Einstein, GPS drifts {c_km} km a day
scenes.narration: Without Einstein, your GPS would drift about {c_km_say} kilometers every day.
In orbit, gravity is weaker, so satellite clocks tick faster: plus {c_gr_say} microseconds a day.
But they also fly fast, and that slows them by {c_sr_say}.

scenes.label: ahead of clocks on the ground
scenes.narration: Net result: {c_us_say} microseconds ahead every day.
Tiny, but light covers {c_km_say} kilometers in that time. So the clocks are tuned before launch.
Einstein is literally in your pocket.
